name: Vihar Performance Apparel
description: Engineered for speed, designed for victory.
story: Vihar Performance Apparel is a Hungarian brand specializing in high-performance racing suits and gear. Born from a passion for motorsport and a desire to provide drivers with the competitive edge, Vihar seeks to establish itself as a key player in the apparel market through strategic partnerships and proven results. They aim to associate their brand with winning teams and drivers, boosting brand recognition and driving sales.
